description_en: Queries the information about a resource group for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBResourceGroup接口查询集群的资源组信息
name: DescribeDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: group_name

ClusterMode.description_en:
The working mode of the resource group. Valid values:

Disable (default)
AutoScale
ClusterMode.description_zh:
资源组模式，取值：

Disable（默认）：常规模式。
AutoScale：自动弹性模式

ClusterSizeResource.description_en: The resource specifications of a single compute cluster. Unit: ACU

ConnectionString.description_en:
The endpoint of the resource group.

This parameter is returned only when the value of Engine is SparkWarehouse
ConnectionString.description_zh:
资源组连接地址。

仅Engine为SparkWarehouse时返回该参数

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was created

ElasticMinComputeResource.description_en: The minimum amount of elastic computing resources. Unit: ACU
ElasticMinComputeResource.description_zh: 最小计算弹性资源，单位为ACU

Engine.description_en:
The engine of the resource group. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default)
SparkWarehouse
Engine.description_zh:
资源组引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB for MySQL引擎。
SparkWarehouse：SparkWarehouse引擎

EngineParams.description_en: The Spark application configuration parameters that can be applied to all Spark jobs executed in the resource group. If you want to configure parameters for a specific Spark job, you can specify values for the parameters in the code editor when you submit the job
EngineParams.description_zh: Spark应用配置参数，应用于该资源组执行的所有Spark作业。如需为某个Spark作业单独配置参数，可以在提交作业时通过代码设置

GroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group

GroupType.description_en:
The query execution mode. Valid values:

interactive (default)
batch
job
GroupType.description_zh:
查询类型，取值说明：
interactive（默认值）：交互查询模式。
batch：分批查询模式。
Job：离线查询模式

GroupUserList.description_en: The database accounts that are associated with the resource group
GroupUserList.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号列表

items.description_en: The database account that is associated with the resource group
items.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号

GroupUsers.description_en: The database accounts that are associated with the resource group. Multiple database accounts are separated by commas (,)
GroupUsers.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号列表，多个账号以英文逗号（,）分隔

MaxClusterCount.description_en: The maximum number of compute clusters that are allowed in the resource group. Maximum value: 10
MaxClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内最多可以运行的Cluster个数，最大为10

MaxComputeResource.description_en:
The maximum amount of reserved computing resources, which refers to the amount of resources that are not allocated in the cluster. Unit: ACU.

If the value of GroupType is interactive, the amount of reserved computing resources that are not allocated in the cluster is returned in increments of 16ACU.
If the value of GroupType is job, the amount of reserved computing resources that are not allocated in the cluster is returned in increments of 8ACU
MaxComputeResource.description_zh:
最大计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8 ACU

MinClusterCount.description_en: The minimum number of compute clusters that are required in the resource group. Minimum value: 1
MinClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内至少需要运行的Cluster个数，最小为1

MinComputeResource.description_en:
The minimum amount of reserved computing resources. Unit: AnalyticDB compute unit (ACU).

If the value of GroupType is interactive, 16ACU is returned.
If the value of GroupType is job, 0ACU is returned
MinComputeResource.description_zh:
最小计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0 ACU

NodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes. Each node provides 16 cores and 64 GB memory
NodeNum.description_zh: 节点数量。1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB

Port.description_en:
The port number of the resource group.

This parameter is returned only when the value of Engine is SparkWarehouse
Port.description_zh:
资源组端口号。

仅Engine为SparkWarehouse时返回该参数

RunningClusterCount.description_en: The number of compute clusters running in the resource group
RunningClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内正在运行的Cluster个数

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource group. Valid values:

Pending
Running
Scaling
Deleting
Deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源组状态，取值说明：
Pending：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Scaling：变配中。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was updated
